findings.reason: The fixture's source-string regex finds 'copyFileSync' in an explanatory fail-closed comment, so it rejects the safe production implementation. This was the observed failure on the single run.
findings.required_fix: Change the call-shape assertion so it ignores comments or inspects executable AST/call syntax; alternatively exercise the fail-closed rename behavior with injected dependencies. Keep the safety assertion.

findings.reason: The lock mocks report existsSync() === true for every path and their unlinkSync spy ignores its path. acquireWriterLock always attempts to unlink its own tempLockPath in finally, so these spies become true during setup even though the shared lock was preserved; later assertions at fixture lines 457, 513, 542, and 599 would fail.
findings.required_fix: Use path-aware mock state (for example a Map keyed by exact path). Make existsSync/unlinkSync distinguish the contender-owned tempLockPath from the shared lock path, and assert that only shared-lock deletion is prohibited. Preserve partial-lock, stale-lock, and foreign-replacement assertions.

lifecycle_and_acceptance_limits: Normal observer release intentionally leaves the shared lock. Root exact-owner cleanup is required after the prior observer has been confirmed stopped; this is limited to restarting the local observer and does not gate construction or MCP.

The optional fsImpl.atomicRelinquish seam is trusted external behavior. The production main path uses standard Node fs, which has no such method and therefore takes the safe no-unlink path. The synthetic callback is only a test model, not a verified native atomic filesystem primitive.
Static/source PASS is not a live observer, installed dashboard, provider/MCP/SYSTEM, no-token, reboot, or Mission acceptance. No such state was queried or established.
